interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers and to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian lighting underneath the elevated structure to improve visibility and perceived safety in the shadowed areas.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections to ensure clear sightlines for pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Street Furniture or Planters
interventions.description: Place planters or bollards between the sidewalk and the curb where space permits to create a protective buffer.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder style crosswalk markings at the upcoming intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Improve pedestrian-scale lighting attached to the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and increase safety during all hours.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked mid-block crossing with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees within the buffer zone to enhance the pedestrian environment and provide additional protection.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised crossings to reduce vehicle speeds in this constrained environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the effective width of the pedestrian walkway to meet ADA standards and improve comfort.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Buffers
interventions.description: Install planters or bollards to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and safety during all hours.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-quality, pedestrian-scale lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Incentives
interventions.description: Encourage the replacement of blank fences with more transparent or active land uses to improve natural surveillance.

interventions.title: Under-deck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-oriented lighting fixtures to the underside of the rail structure to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with appropriate signage and curb extensions to provide a designated and safer place to cross the street.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Complete repaving of the street to eliminate potholes and patches, improving safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-output, pedestrian-scale LED lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety under the elevated structure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement stricter parking enforcement to prevent sidewalk encroachment and ensure a clear walking path around structural pillars.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-scale LED lighting attached to the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing zebra markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to ensure the crossing is conspicuous to drivers despite the overhead structure.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pillar Treatments
interventions.description: Apply reflective paint or high-visibility wraps to the support columns to alert drivers and pedestrians to their presence.
